info.title: upaffe
info.description: The HTTP surface of one upaffe instance. Every endpoint is under /api; every response carries Upaffe-Version.

get.summary: Whether the upaffe process can answer.
Whether PostgreSQL answers with the expected schema.
Whether this instance still needs and can accept its one-time bootstrap.

post.summary: Establish the sole operator using the bounded bootstrap proof.
Sign in as the operator; the new session is returned as an HttpOnly cookie.

get.summary: Inspect the operator identity admitted by the current browser session.

delete.summary: Revoke and forget the current browser session.

post.summary: Submit an idempotent success or failure to one push monitor.
Create a named management credential and reveal its token once.

get.summary: List management credential metadata without any token.

post.summary: Rotate a credential, reveal the new token once, and overlap the prior token briefly.

delete.summary: Revoke every token belonging to a management credential immediately.

post.summary: Create a project idempotently by its immutable key.

get.summary: List live projects, or deleted projects when deleted=true.
Read a live or deleted project by its immutable key.

put.summary: Rename a live project at the version last read.

delete.summary: Soft-delete a project at the version last read.

post.summary: Restore a deleted project at the version last read.
Create an HTTP monitor idempotently by its project-scoped key.

get.summary: List live HTTP monitors in one project.
Read an HTTP monitor without returning secret values.

put.summary: Update non-secret HTTP monitor configuration and optionally replace its target URL.

delete.summary: Remove an HTTP monitor while retaining its history and key.

get.summary: List completed HTTP checks newest first with cursor pagination.
List HTTP incidents newest first with cursor pagination.

post.summary: Pause an HTTP monitor at the version last read.
Resume an HTTP monitor and make a fresh check due.

put.summary: Set or replace one write-only HTTP request header.

delete.summary: Remove one write-only HTTP request header.

post.summary: Run one immediate HTTP check through the shared bounded executor.
Create a push monitor idempotently by its project-scoped key.

get.summary: List live push monitors in one project.
Read a push monitor without its reporting secret.

put.summary: Update push monitor configuration at the version last read.

delete.summary: Remove a push monitor while retaining history and its key.

post.summary: Resume a push monitor with a fresh reporting window.
Issue and reveal a monitor reporting secret once.

get.summary: Read reporting credential metadata without its secret.

delete.summary: Revoke the monitor reporting credential immediately.

post.summary: Rotate and reveal a new reporting secret once.
